hooks.name: DSP property tests on save
hooks.description: Whenever modem or packet code changes, run the property-based round-trip tests and report any counterexample.

action.prompt: Modem or packet code changed. Run `npx vitest run tests/modem tests/packet`. If any fast-check property fails, show the shrunk counterexample, explain the root cause in one paragraph, and propose a minimal fix. Do not weaken the property.
